description: This layer maps the public health facilities in Malawi that charge no user fees, such as health centres and dispensaries, with the coordinates checked against two official sources. The producers are Patrick Kalonde of the Malawi-Liverpool-Wellcome Trust Clinical Research Programme and Michelle Stanton of the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, who combined locations from the Ministry of Health's Malawi Health Facility Registry with those recorded in the national DHIS2 health information system. Coverage is national Malawi; district and central hospitals and fee-charging facilities are deliberately left out, because the layer was built to study access to free primary care. The shapefile is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, and the registry itself is online. Caveats: a 2025 snapshot, hospitals excluded, and attribute fields are not documented in the deposit. Simulation uses: computing travel times and catchments to primary care, testing how floods or cyclones that cut roads isolate communities from their facility, and planning outreach. Related records: the modelled catchment areas for Malawi (data-malawi-modelled-health-facility-catchments) are built from these facilities, AccessMod (model-accessmod) computes such catchments, and healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives open facility points worldwide.
